newsitem.title: USA: Xavier Corp says warrants handled properly.
newsitem.headline: Xavier Corp says warrants handled properly.

text.p: Xavier Corp said Wednesday its outside board members concluded it properly handled two investment funds managed by Morgan Grenfell Asset Management.
Morgan Grenfell is an institutional shareholder of Xavier Corp.

The company said it properly disclosed and accounted for the warrants issued to Russ Oil and Technology SA to purchase 15.5 million shares of Xavier Mines Ltd, or 3.9 million post-split shares of Xavier Corp.
The company said it also properly handled a related loan to D. Carnegie AB for 140 million Swedish Kroner, or $20.78 million.

Xavier's statement comes in response to news reports about a review by British regulatory authorities of the two investment funds. In early September, Xavier Corp said the warrants and the related loan were fully disclosed in its Form S-4 registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in May.
